quest.title: Unbegun, Unending Story
quest.description: The sacrifice demanded by magic is consolation...

talks.objective: Enter the room on the lower level of the Knights of Favonius Library

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. What's a place like this doing in a library? Could this be the Restricted Section Lisa mentioned?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, doesn't quite feel like it, though...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...You don't think this place is hiding some terrible secret, do you? Like those rooms you always hear about in scary stories? Y'know, the ones that are usually totally off limits?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely it would be locked if that were the case.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true... We just kinda waltzed in here. And it didn't seem like the lock had been broken or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, hang on a minute! This isn't the door we came in through! Are we even in the library anymore?

choices.text: We could be underneath Cider Lake?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You think? Wow. That's pretty impressive, building all this under the lake... Wait, no, that's ridiculous! No way is that where we are.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Too bad Lisa's not working today, otherwise we could ask her... Well, we're here anyhow, and this place doesn't look too dangerous. Why don't we take a look around?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: New places are meant for exploring, after all! You've gotta try all kinds of new things to become a good and experienced guide.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, look, a stuffed wolf toy! So cute!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's so fluffy and soft! Huh, wonder who left it here...

choices.text: For all you know, that toy might be this room's real master.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Awoooo! Foolish Traveler! You dare enter this fortress of doom without invitation! Prepare to be eaten alive!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...We should probably just leave it here for now. This place is huge, so let's keep on exploring!

choices.text: Or it might be the guardian of this mysterious room.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What sorta guardian would be dozing away on the sofa like this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "*snore* No danger in sight... Saw nothing, means nothing happened... *snore*"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And what world would that be, huh?
